Stock market news | Swiggy Instamart to cut 340 jobs amid business restructuring

Swiggy's quick delivery arm, Instamart, is set to lay off 340 employees as it restructures the business for its next stage of growth. The move comes as the company sharpens its focus on profitability and widen its adoption of AI.
